name: Kue Mbak Ani
tagline: Jajanan pasar and snack boxes, baked and steamed every morning.
about: Two sisters selling traditional Indonesian snacks from their front porch, now taking orders for events.
payment: Bank transfer before delivery or cash on pickup.

items.name: Snack Box (3 pieces)
items.description: Risoles mayo, kue lumpur and lemper ayam in a paper box.

items.name: Snack Box (4 pieces)
items.description: Snack Box 3 plus a slice of bolu pandan.

items.name: Risoles Mayo
items.description: Crispy crepe roll with smoked beef, egg and mayonnaise.

items.name: Kue Lumpur
items.description: Soft potato and coconut milk cake with raisins.

items.name: Klepon
items.description: Pandan rice balls filled with palm sugar, rolled in coconut.

policies: Orders can be changed up to 8 hours before delivery.
Snacks are best eaten the same day.
